'''Looca B'Nash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] living during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Looca B'Nash lived on the moon [[Pinett]] where he made his living as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaeth]]. After the [[Corsignis Property Alliance]] and the [[Jon-Tow Economic Development Group]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] Pinett as a result of a trade dispute, the [[Pinett Freedom Force]], a local protest movement, attempted to prevent Corsignis and Jon-Tow [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from landing on the moon. However, a number of port workers became disgruntled as a result of the Freedom Force's actions, and under the leadership of Jaeth and B'Nash, the port workers began to cause trouble for the Freedom Force.
